description:
Research a trademark holder on the open web and return a cited dossier: who they
    really are (an operating company, a shell, a known squatter), their notable
    trademark activity or disputes, and any red flags. Signed-in.

    Spends one credit — included credits first, then purchased ones. A failed run
    costs nothing, and calling again for the same holder within 30 minutes returns that
    dossier at no charge (`reused: true`). The dossier is AI-written from cited web
    sources: research to check, not register fact. For the register facts on a
    holder, holder_read and company_file cost no credits.
name: run_investigation
title: Investigate a holder (spends a credit)
